summary: fractal-ui kit: gated workbench and composer, single-commit transcript pane mount, and blue addition tint in place of green palette defaults

replay.detail: UI development components only; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: No client protocol or deployed runtime compatibility change; workbench layouts and composer drafts are browser-local story/host state. Package entry change: @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui/shell no longer re-exports DiffPanel, because its source highlighting loads the Markdown grammar graph and the shell entry stays runtime-free. Hosts import DiffPanel from @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui instead.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; identity and state are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
